'''Tractor drones''' were basically consisting of a humanoid head and torso connected to a long cargo sleigh on treaded wheels. One such droid took part in [[Z-X3|Zee-Exthree's]] [[Kligson's Moon civil war|rebellion]] on [[Kligson's Moon/Legends|Kligson's Moon]].
